scope: Proposition 4.5 of the manuscript “Uniform Pluricanonical Iitaka Fibrations” (preprints/Uniform-Pluricanonical-Iitaka-Fibrations-October-3-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88c226e29ee72119), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a dimension d, a rational DCC set I ⊂ [0, 1], and a positive integer p. There is an integer ℓ = ℓ(d, I, p) > 0 with the following property. Let Z be a normal projective complex variety of dimension d with a rationally connected smooth projective resolution. Suppose (Z, B +MZ) is generalized klt, B ≥ 0 has coefficients in I, the b-nef data satisfy pM b-Cartier, and D = KZ + B + MZ ∼Q 0. Then ℓD is an integral principal divisor.
